T1059.001.document:
Technique ID: T1059.001
Name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
Tactic: Execution
Description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for executing malicious code, downloading payloads from remote command and control servers, and automating discovery or lateral movement. PowerShell is widely used for administrative tasks, making malicious usage easy to blend with benign activity. (Kẻ tấn công lạm dụng PowerShell để thực thi lệnh độc hại, tải script từ xa qua mạng, thực thi fileless và làm bàn đạp mở rộng tấn công).
Detection: Monitor process creation events for powershell.exe with flags like -enc, -EncodedCommand, -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, -NoProfile, -WindowStyle Hidden. Monitor Script Block Logging (Windows Event ID 4104) for suspicious cmdlets like IEX, DownloadString, Invoke-WebRequest, and Start-Process. Enable Antimalware Scan Interface (AMSI).
Mitigations: Enforce PowerShell Constrained Language Mode via AppLocker or Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC). Restrict PowerShell execution policies across group policies (GPO). Disable or uninstall PowerShell version 2.0 to prevent downgrade attacks.

T1078.002.document:
Technique ID: T1078.002
Name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
Tactic: Defense Evasion, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Initial Access
Description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing domain accounts to gain access, maintain persistence, elevate privileges, and evade defense mechanisms. Compromised domain credentials allow attackers to mimic legitimate domain users and administrators. (Kẻ tấn công lừa đảo đánh cắp thông tin tài khoản miền domain, chiếm đoạt mật khẩu quản trị viên để đăng nhập và kiểm soát toàn bộ hệ thống).
Detection: Audit Windows Security Event ID 4624 (Successful logon) for unusual logon types (Type 3 network logon or Type 10 RemoteInteractive), anomalous logon hours, logins from unauthorized IP addresses, and sudden access spikes to sensitive servers. Monitor Kerberos Ticket-Granting Service requests (Event ID 4769) for abnormal Kerberoasting activity.
Mitigations: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all domain logons and VPN access. Deploy Privileged Access Workstations (PAW) and tier-based administration. Enforce strong password complexity, implement LAPS (Local Administrator Password Solution), and rotate domain admin credentials regularly.

T1046.document:
Technique ID: T1046
Name: Network Service Discovery
Tactic: Discovery
Description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services and open ports running on remote hosts through port scanning and service probing. This allows attackers to identify vulnerable listening services, management ports like RDP/SSH/SMB, and network topology. (Hành vi quét cổng mạng, dò quét cổng dịch vụ mở SYN scan, xác định các cổng dịch vụ khả dụng trên hệ thống mạng nội bộ).
Detection: Detect rapid connection attempts from a single internal or external host across multiple destination IP addresses and ports within a short time window. Analyze Zeek conn.log, Suricata/Snort alerts, and firewall connection drops for SYN scan patterns.
Mitigations: Segment internal network into discrete VLANs with micro-segmentation. Configure host-based firewalls to deny inbound traffic by default. Close all unnecessary listening ports and disable unneeded services.

T1027.document:
Technique ID: T1027
Name: Obfuscated/Encoded Files or Information
Tactic: Defense Evasion
Description: Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or script difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, compressing, or otherwise obfuscating its content and command-line arguments. Common methods include Base64 encoding, XOR obfuscation, string reversal, and variable substitution. (Mã hóa, làm rối chuỗi lệnh và che giấu file thực thi nhằm vượt qua phần mềm diệt virus và giải pháp EDR).
Detection: Audit process creation command lines for high-entropy strings, Base64 patterns, complex concatenation operators, and packed executables. Inspect script executions de-obfuscated dynamically by AMSI (Antimalware Scan Interface).
Mitigations: Deploy endpoint detection tools supporting behavioral analysis and runtime in-memory inspection. Restrict execution of unsigned scripts and binaries using WDAC or AppLocker.

T1053.005.document:
Technique ID: T1053.005
Name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
Tactic: Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation
Description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows Task Scheduler to register scheduled tasks that execute malicious binaries, scripts, or payloads at system startup or recurring intervals. (Tạo tác vụ lên lịch định kỳ bằng schtasks để duy trì quyền truy cập lâu dài trên hệ thống).
Detection: Monitor Windows Security Event ID 4698 (A scheduled task was created), Event ID 4702 (Scheduled task updated), and Sysmon Event ID 1 for executions of schtasks.exe with parameters /create, /change, or /run.
Mitigations: Restrict permissions to create and modify scheduled tasks to local and domain administrators only. Regularly audit scheduled task entries in C:\Windows\System32\Tasks and registry keys under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Schedule\TaskCache.

T1071.001.document:
Technique ID: T1071.001
Name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
Tactic: Command and Control
Description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer web protocols (HTTP, HTTPS) to disguise command and control (C2) traffic, exfiltrate data, and blend in with regular enterprise web browsing traffic. (Kênh điều khiển C2 qua giao thức web HTTP/HTTPS).
Detection: Analyze web proxy and firewall logs for periodic beaconing intervals, anomalous User-Agent strings, long URI queries, and direct connections to newly registered domains (NRDs) or dynamic DNS services. Inspect encrypted traffic via SSL/TLS decryption.
Mitigations: Route all outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic through an enterprise proxy with SSL inspection. Block uncategorized or malicious domains using DNS sinkholing and Threat Intelligence feeds.

T1566.002.document:
Technique ID: T1566.002
Name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
Tactic: Initial Access
Description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails containing malicious hyperlinks to lure targeted individuals into visiting credential harvesting login pages or downloading weaponized payloads. (Hình thức lừa đảo qua email chứa liên kết độc hại, dụ nạn nhân đăng nhập vào trang web giả mạo để lấy cắp mật khẩu tài khoản hoặc cài cắm mã độc).
Detection: Inspect inbound emails with secure email gateways (SEG) for domain spoofing, URL redirection, and brand impersonation. Monitor web browser process invocations initiated from mail client processes such as outlook.exe.
Mitigations: Implement email authentication mechanisms including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Deploy web proxy URL sandboxing, mandate Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and conduct continuous anti-phishing user training.

T1021.002.document:
Technique ID: T1021.002
Name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
Tactic: Lateral Movement
Description: Adversaries may leverage SMB file sharing and administrative network shares (C$, ADMIN$, IPC$) to transfer malicious files, execute commands remotely, and propagate laterally across domain workstations. (Lợi dụng chia sẻ tệp tin SMB và admin share để di chuyển ngang trong mạng nội bộ).
Detection: Monitor Windows Security Event ID 5140 (A network share object was accessed), Event ID 5145 (Detailed network share access), and Sysmon Event ID 3 for outbound TCP port 445 connections to internal hosts.
Mitigations: Disable SMBv1 entirely. Block inbound TCP port 445 between internal workstation subnets using host firewalls. Use LAPS to prevent local administrator credential reuse across endpoints.

T1110.document:
Technique ID: T1110
Name: Brute Force
Tactic: Credential Access
Description: Adversaries may use brute force attacks (including password spraying, credential stuffing, and dictionary guessing) to guess passwords and systematically compromise user accounts. (Tấn công vét cạn mật khẩu dò tìm thông tin đăng nhập tự động qua SSH, RDP, Web).
Detection: Detect a surge of failed authentication attempts in a short timeframe (Windows Event ID 4625, Linux sshd authentication failures, Wazuh rule 5710/5712). Monitor Event ID 4740 for multiple account lockout occurrences.
Mitigations: Enforce strict account lockout thresholds after consecutive failed attempts. Mandate complex passwords, deploy rate limiting on login interfaces, and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

T1486.document:
Technique ID: T1486
Name: Data Encrypted for Impact
Tactic: Impact
Description: Adversaries may encrypt critical data and documents on local drives and shared network storage, interrupting operational workflows and demanding financial ransom for the decryption keys. (Mã độc tống tiền ransomware mã hóa tệp tin hàng loạt gây gián đoạn hệ thống).
Detection: Detect abnormal high-frequency file modifications and renames with new unknown file extensions. Monitor for process executions attempting to delete Volume Shadow Copies (e.g., vssadmin delete shadows, wbadmin). Check Sysmon Event 11 for rapid file creation of ransom notes.
Mitigations: Maintain offline, immutable, and air-gapped backups. Implement EDR anti-ransomware behavioral monitoring to automatically terminate rogue encryption processes. Restrict write permissions on shared network drives.

T1056.002.document:
Technique ID: T1056.002
Name: Input Capture: GUI Input Capture
Tactic: Credential Access, Collection
Description: Adversaries may mimic a legitimate dialog box, prompt, or capture graphical user interface inputs to obtain credentials from users. This includes prompting fake Windows logon dialogs, harvesting credentials via fake Office 365 or portal prompts. (Kẻ tấn công lừa đảo hiển thị cửa sổ nhập mật khẩu giả mạo GUI hoặc thu thập thông tin đăng nhập trực tiếp từ giao diện người dùng).
Detection: Detect unusual processes spawning credential prompt dialogs (e.g., PowerShell invoking Windows Forms or WPF credential prompts). Monitor for Credential UI APIs like CredUIPromptForWindowsCredentials. Inspect event logs for abnormal user authentication events occurring immediately after an untrusted process creation.
Mitigations: Mandate Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) with FIDO2/WebAuthn keys. Train users to recognize suspicious dialog boxes and never enter domain credentials into unexpected pop-ups. Enforce Credential Guard on Windows 10/11 enterprise systems.

T1018.document:
Technique ID: T1018
Name: Remote System Discovery
Tactic: Discovery
Description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of other systems by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifiers on a network through ICMP ping sweeps, ARP broadcasts, or Active Directory computer queries. This reconnaissance enables adversaries to plan lateral movement paths. (Kỹ thuật dò quét và lập danh sách các máy chủ hoạt động trong mạng nội bộ thông qua ping sweep ICMP hoặc truy vấn Active Directory).
Detection: Monitor network traffic and firewall drop/pass logs for sudden high volumes of ICMP Echo Requests sent across subnets from a single source host within a brief timeframe. Audit command-line executions of net view, ping, arp -a, and Test-Connection in Sysmon Event ID 1.
Mitigations: Configure internal network firewalls to block unnecessary ICMP sweeps between workstation subnets. Implement network segmentation and micro-segmentation to limit visibility across subnets.

T1087.document:
Technique ID: T1087
Name: Account Discovery
Tactic: Discovery
Description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of local or domain accounts to determine which accounts exist on the system and which have elevated administrative privileges. This includes enumerating Active Directory users, domain administrators, and service accounts. (Dò quét và thu thập danh sách tài khoản người dùng, tài khoản quản trị miền Domain Admins nhằm phục vụ bước leo thang đặc quyền).
Detection: Monitor process command lines for tools like net user, net group, dsquery, Get-ADUser, and PowerView cmdlets. Monitor Windows Security Event ID 4661 (Handle to an object was requested) and Event 4798/4799 for abnormal domain group enumeration.
Mitigations: Restrict permissions for standard domain users to query sensitive Active Directory objects and groups. Enable Active Directory auditing and deploy Honey Accounts (Decoy accounts) to detect unauthorized reconnaissance.

T1087.002.document:
Technique ID: T1087.002
Name: Account Discovery: Domain Account
Tactic: Discovery
Description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of domain accounts to identify targeted individuals, privileged administrators, and service accounts in the Active Directory environment. (Thu thập thông tin tài khoản miền Active Directory để chọn mục tiêu tấn công và leo quyền).
Detection: Audit Windows Security Event ID 4672 (Special privileges assigned) and Event ID 4624 for unusual administrative logon sessions. Monitor network traffic to Domain Controllers on LDAP/LDAPS (ports 389/636) and RPC (port 135/445).
Mitigations: Implement Least Privilege Access. Restrict RPC and LDAP queries from non-administrative endpoints. Monitor Active Directory replication traffic.

60106.document:
Wazuh Rule ID: 60106
Severity Level: 8
Description: Windows Event - PowerShell execution with encoded/suspicious command (Phát hiện PowerShell thực thi lệnh mã hóa Base64 hoặc tải script từ xa)
MITRE ATT&CK IDs: T1059.001, T1027
Remediation: Immediately isolate the infected host from the network. Kill the running powershell.exe process and extract full command-line arguments. Review PowerShell Script Block logs (Event ID 4104) to analyze decoded script contents. Scan system memory for injected payloads.

92211.document:
Wazuh Rule ID: 92211
Severity Level: 10
Description: Web attack - SQL Injection attempt detected via HTTP query or POST body (Tấn công SQL Injection vào ứng dụng web thông qua tham số HTTP)
MITRE ATT&CK IDs: T1190
Remediation: Add attacker IP address to perimeter firewall or WAF ban list immediately. Sanitize and parameterize all SQL queries within the vulnerable web application codebase. Inspect database query logs to verify if data exfiltration or table modification occurred.

5710.document:
Wazuh Rule ID: 5710
Severity Level: 5
Description: SSH insecure connection attempt - Unauthorized host or failed login attempt (Đăng nhập SSH thất bại từ địa chỉ không xác thực)
MITRE ATT&CK IDs: T1110
Remediation: Check source IP reputation against threat intelligence feeds. Verify whether the attempt was an authorized user typo. If repetitive, trigger Wazuh Active Response to ban source IP for 1 hour.

metadata.remediation: Check source IP reputation against threat intelligence feeds. Verify whether the attempt was an authorized user typo. If repetitive, trigger Wazuh Active Response to ban source IP for 1 hour.

5715.document:
Wazuh Rule ID: 5715
Severity Level: 3
Description: SSH authentication succeeded (Đăng nhập SSH thành công vào hệ thống Linux)
MITRE ATT&CK IDs: T1078.002, T1078
Remediation: Validate source IP and username against approved administrative maintenance rosters. Enforce SSH key-based authentication and disable root password logins over SSH.

metadata.remediation: Validate source IP and username against approved administrative maintenance rosters. Enforce SSH key-based authentication and disable root password logins over SSH.

60115.document:
Wazuh Rule ID: 60115
Severity Level: 10
Description: Windows Event - A scheduled task was created via schtasks or API (Tạo scheduled task mới trên hệ điều hành Windows)
MITRE ATT&CK IDs: T1053.005
